_description: Local modifications to the installed EMC field tree (~/emc/field). The stock/ copies are the vendor baseline; the .patch files reproduce the installed state from it. orchestration/scripts/emc_fields.py --verify checks the installed tree against these hashes; --patched-rows feeds ff_provenance.py the set of locally authored parameter rows.

hunks.reason: PDMS/PSIL typing. Without these, EMC assigns no type to Si or siloxane O and the build fails.
Same five rules mirrored into the .define RULES blocks.
Bond-increment charges for siloxane and silanol oxygen. Locally chosen values.
Angle terms reaching the silanol chain terminus. Locally chosen values.

Zero-barrier terminal-cap torsions. These follow the stock field's own convention: stock opls-aa.prm already carries `o2 si4 o2 si4 0 1 0` and `c4 si4 o2 si4 0 1 0`, so the zero-barrier Si-O-Si backbone rotation in PDMS is STOCK OPLS-AA behaviour, not a local invention. The rows added here are the silanol/amine-terminated analogues of rows that already existed.

opls/2024/opls-aa.note: Applied 2026-06-05 for PDMS/PSIL, which polymer_rules.json routes to this field as its only option. The installed EMC tree was updated 2026-08-05 and these edits survived; nothing guarantees the next update preserves them.

unpatched_verified.pcff/pcff_templates.dat: identical to its .bak — PCFF, the field 32 of 36 archived runs used, carries no local modification
